consequence.statement: Prometheus scrape configurations or monitoring queries that reference the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` will no longer find that metric; the metric is only available under its new name `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total`.
consequence.remediation: Update Prometheus scrape configurations, dashboards, and alerting rules to reference the new metric name `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` instead of the old name `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count`.

original.statement: The Prometheus metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` has been renamed to `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` in Cilium 1.17.0.

consequence.statement: Prometheus queries, dashboards and alerting rules that reference `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` will no longer find that metric after the upgrade, because it has been renamed. The 1.17 upgrade notes list both `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` and `doublewrite_kvstore_identities` as its new name.
consequence.remediation: Check which name the 1.17.0 cilium-agent actually exposes (`doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` or `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`), then update queries, dashboards and alerts that reference `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` to use that name.

corrected.statement: In Cilium 1.17.0 the metric `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` is no longer exported under that name. The upgrade notes give two different new names for it: `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` and `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`. Monitoring that references the old name stops receiving data.

decision.reason: The proposed consequence names `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total` as the only new name, and that is the problem. In the same 1.17 Changed Metrics section, [ev-d6005e84dee9] gives that name, but [ev-2349d1c09109] says the same old metric was renamed to `doublewrite_kvstore_identities`. Both entries agree that the old name `doublewrite_identity_kvstore_total_count` is gone, so anything still querying it will no longer find it. I keep setting-ignored but drop the single new name from the statement and remediation, and tell operators to check which name the 1.17 agent actually emits.
